evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Native pipeline jargon ('rollback') framed as a plain-spoken aphorism — the maxim crystallizes a technical policy into accessible matched opposition, a register signature departure from the document's matter-of-fact baseline.
